items.title: Booking Creation and Conflict Prevention
items.description: Enable users to find and reserve rooms while ensuring no double bookings.

items.title: Visibility and Administration
items.description: Provide appropriate visibility of bookings to users and administrators.

items.title: Sign in with college account
items.description: As a student or staff, I want to sign in with my college account, so that I can access the booking system securely.

criteria.text: When a user provides valid college credentials, they are logged in and can reach the booking interface.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

items.title: Search rooms by date, time and capacity
items.description: As a user, I want to search rooms by date, time and capacity, so that I can find a suitable room.

criteria.text: Given a date, time range and required capacity, the system returns a list of rooms that are free.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity

items.title: Create a one‑off booking up to 4 hours
items.description: As a user, I want to book a one‑off slot up to 4 hours, so that I can reserve a room for my study session.

criteria.text: When a user selects a free room and a time slot of 1‑4 hours, the booking is created and shown in the system.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.

items.title: Prevent overlapping bookings
items.description: As the system, I reject overlapping bookings for the same room, so that double bookings are prevented.

criteria.text: When a user attempts to book a room during a period that overlaps an existing booking, the request is refused and the user is told the room is unavailable.

citations.quote: If two people can take the same room at the same time, we have failed.
The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

items.title: Block rooms for maintenance
items.description: As facilities staff, I can block a room for maintenance, so that it is not bookable during that period.

criteria.text: When a facilities user marks a room as blocked for a time range, the room no longer appears in search results for those times.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

items.title: Admin view of who booked each room
items.description: As facilities staff, I can see who booked each room, so that I have a complete view of usage.

criteria.text: In the admin dashboard, each booking entry displays the name of the user who made the booking.

citations.quote: my office needs to see who booked each room

items.title: User view of room availability only
items.description: As a student or staff, I see that a room is taken but not who booked it, so that privacy is maintained.

criteria.text: When a user searches for rooms, occupied rooms are shown as unavailable without revealing the booking holder's identity.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it

questions.subject: Cancellation and no‑show policy
questions.question: What specific rules (e.g., deadline, penalty, notification) should apply for cancellations and no‑shows?
questions.why_it_matters: The system needs concrete, testable behavior for handling bookings that cannot be attended.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking.
We need a rule for no-shows, and for how late someone can cancel
cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms

questions.subject: Maximum booking length
questions.question: Should the system enforce a 3‑hour or a 4‑hour maximum booking length for a single slot?
questions.why_it_matters: Conflicting statements affect validation logic and user expectations.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.
three hours is the most I want for a single booking
